title: Israeli Strike Destroys Al-Aqsa Hospital Medicine Warehouses in Deir al-Balah
detail: An overnight Israeli strike destroyed medicine storage facilities belonging to Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza, on August 1, 2026. Gaza's Health Ministry said two of the four storage warehouses were completely destroyed and the other two badly damaged, wiping out intravenous fluids, medicines, dialysis supplies, and intensive care materials; the facility received only a 15-minute evacuation warning. The Israeli military said it struck a Hamas hideout near the hospital allegedly used to store weapons but did not disclose supporting evidence. Separate strikes across Gaza City (Sheikh Radwan, Al-Reis, Al-Thalatini Street) and Khan Younis killed at least 7 Palestinians and wounded 76 over the preceding 48 hours, coming just two days after the Board of Peace disarmament agreement was announced.

title: Civil Defence Completes Recovery of 112 Bodies From 2023 Sabra Strike Rubble
detail: Palestinian Civil Defence crews completed a 17-day operation on August 1, 2026 to recover the remains of 112 people — members of the Abu Shari'a and al-Hasayna families, including 40 children, 38 women, and 7 people with disabilities — from beneath the rubble of homes in the Sabra neighborhood, south of Gaza City. The families were killed when an Israeli strike flattened the residential block on November 23, 2023, in an incident that killed over 300 people in total; the bodies of 41 others from the same strike have still not been recovered. The recovered remains were buried in a mass funeral in Gaza City on August 4, attended by thousands of mourners. Gaza officials estimate close to 15,000 people remain missing under rubble across the Strip, far above the roughly 6,000 officially registered.

media.caption: Mourners gather in Gaza City for the mass funeral of 112 people recovered from the 2023 Sabra strike rubble
